title: Parish and Inheritance
author: B. M. Sterling
blurb: Freya Winterbourne, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
